# confluent_switchover_endpoint Data Source

[![Preview](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lifecycle%20Stage-Preview-%2300afba)](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/api.html#section/Versioning/API-Lifecycle-Policy)

!> **Warning:** Switchover is a preview feature. Preview features are introduced to gather customer feedback and may change based on that feedback. They are intended for evaluation and non-production use only, and are not covered by Confluent SLAs. Preview features may be discontinued at any time.

`confluent_switchover_endpoint` describes a switchover endpoint data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "confluent" {
  cloud_api_key    = var.confluent_cloud_api_key    # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_KEY env var
  cloud_api_secret = var.confluent_cloud_api_secret # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET env var
}

data "confluent_switchover_endpoint" "example" {
  id              = "se-abc123"
  environment_crn = "crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123"
}

output "switchover_endpoint" {
  value = data.confluent_switchover_endpoint.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `id` - (Required String) The ID of the switchover endpoint, for example, `se-abc123`.
- `environment_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the environment that owns this switchover endpoint, for example, `crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the preceding arguments, the following attributes are exported:

- `display_name` - (Required String) A human-readable name for the switchover endpoint.
- `parent_resource_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the switchover pair this endpoint is bound to.
- `target` - (Required String) The name of the endpoint that is currently active.
- `endpoints` (Required Configuration Block) The endpoint definitions, one per side. Each block exports the following:
  - `name` - (Required String) A logical name for this endpoint side.
  - `hostname` - (Required String) The resolved hostname for this endpoint.
  - `cloud` - (Required String) The cloud provider this endpoint resolves to.
  - `region` - (Required String) The cloud region this endpoint resolves to.
  - `connection_type` - (Required String) The connection type this endpoint resolves to.
  - `endpoint_filter` (Required Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `type` - (Required String) Whether the endpoint is `private` or `public`.
    - `network_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the network, for network-based private endpoints.
    - `access_point_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the network access point, for access-point (PNI) endpoints.
- `phase` - (Required String) The lifecycle phase of the switchover endpoint.
